requirements.gate: repository discovery returns exact HEAD, branch and dirty candidate sets
repository paths outside explicit permission fail closed
UTF-8 file reads preserve exact bytes and SHA-256
binary/non-UTF8 reads never synthesize text
diff receipts preserve staged, unstaged and untracked candidates
invalid refs and oversized diffs fail closed
patch proposal records Git-parsed target set, source candidates and preimages
traversal, .git targets, ambiguous path encoding and oversized patches fail closed
coding container plan uses pinned image, explicit read-only repo mount, read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and network none
network-enabled coding plans, writable repo mounts and unpinned images fail closed
approval-gated patch mutation revalidates HEAD, patch hash, candidate set and preimages before mutation and conserves HEAD
HEAD drift, patch drift, preimage drift, dirty overlap and unexpected new dirty paths block or roll back mutation
test/lint/type/build/security/benchmark checks produce deterministic read-only isolated execution plans with closed planning arithmetic
required checks that cannot produce a current valid read-only plan block the suite plan; PLANNED is never promoted to PASS without execution evidence
review findings bind to changed file, source SHA-256 and exact line evidence
review findings against unchanged paths or invalid line ranges are rejected
branch/commit/PR mutations require an authorized Git lifecycle surface and cannot be inferred from source presence
live pinned coding container image and engine execution must be demonstrated before CODE-07 PASS
hosted CI must admit executable jobs or independent trusted execution evidence must be frozen
zero unresolved residue inside the declared coding scope before CODING CERTIFIED

certification_rule: Script success, valid plans, or merged source are insufficient; PASS requires applicable executable evidence, frozen runtime/image identity, closed arithmetic, and zero unresolved residue inside scope.
